overview_description.description: zip24 is an on-demand software or “Software-as-a-Service” (SaaS) startup that streamlines operations management functionalities for e-commerce businesses. Via a cloud-based warehouse, delivery management and enterprise resource planning (ERP) solutions package, zip24 forecast orders, facilitate logistic transactions, retail, warehousing, order shipping and fulfilment; and provide end-to-end delivery tracking. Our Warehouse Management System (WMS) guides inventory receiving and put-away, optimizes picking and shipping of orders and advises on inventory replenishment. This service- oriented architecture provides complete integration to popular storefronts, payment gateways, carriers and other third-party (3P) systems. WMS supports business models of retailers, third- party logistic (3PL) companies and online marketplaces. WMS is offered as a pay-as-you-go subscription. Our Delivery Management System (DMS) offers solutions from pickup to the point-of-delivery. DMS features driver apps with white-label premium features, dispatch and support modules, cash on delivery (COD) processing, real-time tracking of all delivery personnel & vehicles with various geo-locating integrations. Plugins, including Magento and Shopify, offer easy order-drop functionalities, including batch/csv from e-commerce websites, supermarkets, pharmacies, restaurants and more. zip24 is a global company with worldwide customers. Founded by Ex-Amazonians and SaaS entrepreneurs in the Middle East and Central Asia regions, we are headquartered in Dubai, UAE, with development and support hub in Tashkent, Uzbekistan, and now in Karachi, Pakistan.
